title: The hollow's live tooth measures the newest measurable PROVED ticket, not a decayed historic one
intention: The hollow's live tooth measures a subject the corpus still holds measurable (the newest PROVED ticket with a small, many-file plan), chosen at run time by a stated rule, instead of a fixed historic ticket whose build later work has made unrevertable.
why: Measured 2026-10-30: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py's live tooth raises HollowUnmeasurable from measure('9579a6f9cec6') at :433, because 9579's build commit 433cdc908813 no longer reverse-applies over cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py after e8b58520aeb9 changed it (ce92eb562cf9's designed refusal). Four more tester proofs red only by running test_hollow.py whole. A fixed historic subject is a snapshot by another name, and it decays as later work edits its files. measure('c9897770efe6') measured cleanly that day in 118.9s with one worktree.
traces_to: Law 9 (a PROVED proof gone red is red until fixed); Law 3 (the instrument's refusal is correct, so the subject moves, not the instrument); the tooth's own rule: invariants, never the day's counts.
how: EXISTS cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py with the live tooth at :379. EXISTS cairn/tools/base/ticket_file.py (plans, read_ticket) and cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py (writes_to, _ticket_path, measure). A helper picks the subject by a stated rule (D1); the live tooth measures it (D1); a tooth proves the rule (D2).
falsifier: Falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py runs green twice under bin/cairn test --exec, and for 1d23d635f7ca: (1) test_the_live_run_reads_every_writes_to_file_it_did_not_skip_for_a_named_reason is green over the ticket _live_subject() names, every invariant it asserts unchanged; (2) test_the_live_subject_is_the_newest_qualifying_proved_ticket is green. The build touches only the proof, which is the instrument, so the hollow reading is a proofs-only build approved by its plan. Wrong intent if the instrument cannot measure ANY recent many-file PROVED ticket (then measure() is broken, not its subject). proven_by = cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py.

decisions.text: D1: THE SUBJECT RULE. In cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py add a module-level function '_live_subject() -> str' directly above test_the_live_run_reads_every_writes_to_file_it_did_not_skip_for_a_named_reason. It imports at call time 'from cairn.tools.base.ticket_file import plans, read_ticket' and 'from cairn.devices.tester.hollow import writes_to, _ticket_path'; takes the tickets dir as _ticket_path('x').parent if that resolves, else Path.home()/'dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets'; for each p in plans(dir), t = read_ticket(p); keeps t when '[PROVED]' is in t.get('workflow_and_state',''), and files = writes_to(t) (a raised exception drops the ticket) has 2 <= len(files) <= 12 and at least 2 files without '/proofs/' in them; sorts the kept by (t.get('date',''), t['id']) descending; returns the first id; raises AssertionError('no PROVED ticket qualifies as the live subject') if none. In the live tooth replace 'measure("9579a6f9cec6", repo_root=_REPO_ROOT, timeout=120)' with 'measure(subject, repo_root=_REPO_ROOT, timeout=120)' where 'subject = _live_subject()' is set before the counting wrapper is installed, and replace 'ticket = json.loads(_ticket_path("9579a6f9cec6").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))' with 'ticket = read_ticket(_ticket_path(subject))' (import read_ticket inside the tooth). Change the docstring's first line to 'THE LIVE FIRING, against the newest measurable PROVED ticket — invariants, never the day's counts.' and add a paragraph: on 2026-10-30 the fixed subject 9579a6f9cec6 became unmeasurable (433cdc908813's hunks no longer reverse-apply over diagnostic.py after e8b58520aeb9), so the subject is chosen by _live_subject()'s rule; the newest build is the one least likely to be overwritten; residue: a newest ticket already overwritten reds this tooth. Every assert after the measurement stays as written.

D2: THE RULE'S TOOTH AND THE KEY. Add 'def test_the_live_subject_is_the_newest_qualifying_proved_ticket():' directly after the live tooth. It calls subject = _live_subject(); reads t = read_ticket(_ticket_path(subject)); asserts '[PROVED]' in t['workflow_and_state'], 2 <= len(writes_to(t)) <= 12, at least 2 of them lack '/proofs/', and subject != '9579a6f9cec6' is NOT asserted (the rule may pick any ticket). It then re-walks plans() itself and asserts no other qualifying ticket has a (date, id) greater than the subject's; returns True. Add to PROVES: '"1d23d635f7ca": {"1": "test_the_live_run_reads_every_writes_to_file_it_did_not_skip_for_a_named_reason", "2": "test_the_live_subject_is_the_newest_qualifying_proved_ticket"}'. Run: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py', twice (the live tooth alone takes about two minutes). Hollow: bin/cairn test --hollow 1d23d635f7ca --proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py (a proofs-only build; the plan names the skipped file).

builder_notes: WHERE: one file, cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py. RUN: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 <proof>' twice. HOLLOW: bin/cairn test --hollow 1d23d635f7ca --proof <proof>. AFTER: the four proofs that run test_hollow.py whole (test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits, test_the_hollow_measures_the_repaired_build, test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument, test_the_tester_records_an_approved_proofs_only_build) are re-run and resealed.
